items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: we still have an uncle living in Northwest Virginia, Lucius Higginbotham

ctx.x: She was born and my uncle had passed but first cousin [.. (too much noise)] there must have been about seven children, three girls and four boys because we still have an uncle living in Northwest Virginia, Lucius Higginbotham.
Is that what your father named a son after him? Lucius, right?
